manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the can with gold logo design, place it in the oval basket with medium storage space, then lift the oval basket with medium storage space.

Task description: The targets are the red jar with a gold logo on the right side of the image and the medium orange oval basket in the middle. Put the jar in the basket, then lift the basket with the jar inside.

Success criteria: The can must be inside the basket, close to and touching its body, with no table contact. Both basket and can must be clearly above their starting positions, with the opening upright and without excessive tilt.

## Execution tips

- Grasp opposing sides of the can's upper-middle body, avoiding the lid and bottom rim. Open slightly wider than the body and confirm both fingers surround it before closing to reduce tipping or slipping, retaining clearance below for insertion into the basket.
- When placing the jar in the basket, choose an area of the opening unobstructed by the handle, leaving room for both the jar and fingertips to pass. If reorienting it, do so above the rim and handle to avoid brushing the basket.
- Release only after the can bottom is supported by the basket bottom, then open gradually and withdraw through a gap, avoiding a suspended drop or carrying the can out.
- To lift the basket, consider an exposed top section of the handle with pad clearance on both sides, away from its rim attachments. Match the opening to handle thickness and confirm a solid grasp, avoiding an edge-only hook that could slip.
- Lift the loaded basket smoothly and upward where possible, minimizing lateral dragging and sudden wrist rotation to avoid tilting it and making the can slide toward the rim.
